verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents that you can "export your directory events data through RESTful commands." Its API also has GET endpoints that return all directly and indirectly bound objects in an organization, so part of the data can be extracted programmatically. There is no documented full-account export or migration-out path, and no export format is named, so 'open formats' is unevidenced. Missing for 10: a documented export of all data types (users, devices, groups, policies, vault), stated open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON/LDIF), offboarding/exit guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: manage and export your directory events data through RESTful commands
Specific GET endpoints will allow you to traverse the JumpCloud Graph to return all indirect and directly bound objects in your organization.
